title: The Tailor of the First Hoarfrost
description: On the morning of first frost, a hedgehog draws silver thread through a fern. By sunrise it will have a coat of lace.
alt: A hedgehog in a brown cloak draws silver thread across a frost-covered fern held in a twig frame beside a hut at sunrise.
pairing: First frost holiday × a hedgehog tailoring frost lace for a fern
